scheme_name: Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research
other_conditions: Applicant must be a woman researcher or entrepreneur holding a regular/long‑term position in an academic, research institute or industrial organization in India or Germany
Applicant must obtain an endorsement/consent letter from the host team
Applicant must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) or endorsement letter from the head of their current institution
Visit must commence within 12 months of the award letter
Awardee must abide by the conduct, rules and regulations of the host country
Awardee must acknowledge IGSTC in all publications and communications related to the grant
benefits_summary: Grant provides up to ₹12 Lakhs per year (or €14,500 per year) for project costs and covers a one‑month research stay with travel, visa, insurance and per‑diem.
documents_required: No Objection Certificate (NOC) or endorsement letter from the head of the institution
